title: It’s mostly paper. So disappointed.
text:
I’m so disappointed. I anxiously awaited the arrival of the Little Passports Science Jr. box for a month only to be severely underwhelmed. It’s mostly paper.
If it was 10$ I would call it, “cute”, however the cost is 25$-30$, so the adjective that came to mind was, “ripoff “.
I received my first box today and also unsubscribed today. Get twice the quality for a fraction of the price at the Dollar Tree or twice the quality for half of the price with Kiwi Crate. Either way don’t do it!
label: negative
